newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CSFB sees $1 bln Xenical sales for Roche.
newsitem.headline: CSFB sees $1 bln Xenical sales for Roche.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston reiterated its forecast that Roche's anti-obesity drug Xenical could become a blockbuster with annual sales of more than $1 billion, but it also cited the risk it could become a "fad".
CSFB put its price target for Roche certificates at 15,400 Swiss francs at end-1998. It did not alter earnings estimates after an expert panel recommended the U.S. FDA approve the drug.

"We have painted a rosy picture for Xenical, but of course we could be wrong," CSFB analyst Genghis Lloyd-Harris wrote in a research note. "The biggest single risk for Xenical...is the development of a 'fad' market" that could boom and collapse.
